rules.description: Florida security of confidential personal information (s. 501.171, F.S.)

individuals.standard: as expeditiously as practicable and without unreasonable delay, but no later than 30 days after the determination of a breach or reason to believe a breach occurred

regulator.standard: as expeditiously as practicable, but no later than 30 days after the determination of the breach; 15 additional days if good cause is given in writing within 30 days

processorToController.standard: as expeditiously as practicable, but no later than 10 days following the determination of the breach of security or reason to believe the breach occurred

versions.notes: Subs. (3) notice to the Department for 500 or more individuals in Florida; subs. (4) individuals within 30 days; subs. (6) third-party agents notify the covered entity within 10 days. History: s. 3, ch. 2014-189 ... s. 25, ch. 2023-201. Modelling baseline 2024-01-01 (text verified in the 2025 statutes).
